blind.description: A stone birdbath or garden basin consisting of a shallow round dish with a segmented, thick rim, supported by a carved baluster pedestal column that rests on a stepped circular base. The surface is textured like aged sandstone or weathered limestone, with mottled patches of green moss or lichen. The geometry is solid and watertight with clean, continuous surfaces, resting firmly and flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A concentric circular structure featuring a wide outer rim segmented into blocks with moss patches, surrounding a shallow circular stone basin floor.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly waist-height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2 feet wide across the basin rim.
